narrative.overview:
The public page is an unbuilt model kit laid out on a cutting mat. Every declared tool is a numbered part still attached to its runner, the bootstrap is the instruction sheet, and the page closes on the dark side of the box. The system is physical and literal: a thing on the page is the mat, a piece of plastic, or a piece of paper, and it is drawn the way that material behaves.

Density is high and even. Parts are small tiles packed into justified rows, the instruction sheet is a ruled grid of step frames, and prose is short and kept to narrow measures. Nothing is ornamental: the grid on the mat, the gates under a part, and the shaded lower edge of the plastic are the decoration, and each one is also structure.

The page is static HTML and CSS with self-hosted fonts. Motion is one short snap, and it is removed under reduced motion.
keyCharacteristics: Three materials carry everything: a green gridded mat, one unpainted grey plastic, and white paper in black line. Dark ink is the fourth surface, used for the box side alone.
One typeface family for reading (Archivo) and one rounded single-stroke face for everything engraved or stamped (M PLUS Rounded 1c).
Depth is cast shadow on the mat in a single dark green tint, plus a shaded lower edge that gives plastic its thickness.
Plastic is rounded, paper is square.
Red appears once, on the caution mark.
The signature interaction is the snap: a part lets go of its gates, lifts, and turns slightly over its shadow.

rules.name: The Three Materials Rule
rules.body: Every surface is the mat, the plastic, or the paper. A new element is assigned to one of them and takes that material's color, corner, and shadow; it does not get a color of its own.

rules.name: The Caution-Only Red Rule
rules.body: Red belongs to the caution mark alone. It is not a link color, an error color, or an accent.

rules.name: The Soft Pair Rule
rules.body: Each ground has exactly one quieter text color: `on-mat-soft` on the mat, `ink-soft` on plastic and paper, `on-ink-soft` on ink. Secondary text uses the pair for its ground and never opacity.

rules.name: The Engraved Rule
rules.body: Anything stamped into the kit is M PLUS Rounded 1c at weight 500, uppercase, letterspaced 0.06em. Anything read as prose or as a name is Archivo.

rules.name: The No Light Weight Rule
rules.body: Archivo runs from 400 for reading to 800 for headlines; names, titles, and actions are 700. Nothing is set lighter than 400.

rules.name: The Tab-Relative Rule
rules.body: Type on a name tab is sized in container units of the tab, so the headline keeps its proportion to the plastic it is moulded into at every width.

rules.name: The Cast Shadow Rule
rules.body: A shadow means an object is lying on the mat. It is always the dark green tint, always falls straight down, and grows only when the object is lifted.

rules.name: The Thickness Rule
rules.body: Plastic gets its depth from a hard band of Plastic Shade along its lower edge. The band has no blur.

dos: Do assign every new element to the mat, the plastic, or the paper, and give it that material's color, corner, and shadow.
Do set stamped text (numbers, counts, labels) in M PLUS Rounded 1c 500, uppercase, 0.06em, and everything read as prose or a name in Archivo.
Do tint every shadow rgb(6 30 21) and let it fall straight down.
Do give plastic its thickness with a hard Plastic Shade band on the lower edge (0.3125rem on a part, 0.375rem on a name tab).
Do keep paper square and ruled in 0.09375rem ink, and draw figures in outline on a 1.75 stroke.
Do pair each ground with its own soft text color: `on-mat-soft`, `ink-soft`, `on-ink-soft`.
Do switch the focus ring to Kit Ink on plastic and paper and keep it On Mat on the mat.
Do use the single 140ms snap for every state change, and keep every description reachable without motion and without hover.
Do keep the part lists generated; style the part, never retype it.
donts: Don't use Caution Red anywhere but the caution mark.
Don't add a bounce, an overshoot, or a second timing to the snap.
Don't round the corners of paper, or square the corners of plastic.
Don't use a neutral black or grey shadow; shadows are the dark green tint.
Don't introduce a color that is not one of the three materials or the ink.
Don't set a headline in the engraved face or a part number in Archivo.
Don't load a font, script, or image from another origin; the two typefaces are self-hosted.
